crew_onboarding_install_browsers_detail: Chromium and WebKit, for screenshots of UI work.
crew_onboarding_install_check_detail: Looks at the system, systemd and sudo. Changes nothing.
crew_onboarding_install_checklist_idle_d: About two minutes. Nothing on the server changes until its check passes.
crew_onboarding_install_done_detail: Adds the server to your list.
crew_onboarding_install_service_detail: Atlas runs as a systemd service and restarts itself.
crew_onboarding_install_signin_detail: Opens an SSH connection to the server.
crew_onboarding_install_ssh_detail: Lets this computer connect to that user.
crew_onboarding_install_user_detail: A separate user your crew runs as.
